description: One node for TikTok: a creator's profile stats, their latest 10 videos, 10 videos for any hashtag, or the top 20 comments on a video. Each action has a price. Use it when: A task needs public TikTok data: vetting a creator, tracking what a brand or hashtag posts, or reading how people react in comments. Not for: Downloading videos, follower lists, private accounts or messages. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 45 s. Actions: profile (a creator's stats and latest video; needs handle); videos (a creator's latest 10 videos; needs handle); hashtag (10 videos for a hashtag; needs hashtag); comments (top 20 comments on a video; needs url). Price: from $0.004 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on action: profile $0.004, videos $0.028, comments $0.028, hashtag $0.043 (default profile). One call = one TikTok action (profile, videos, hashtag or comments).

action.description: What to do; sets the price. profile (needs handle), videos (needs handle), hashtag (needs hashtag), comments (needs url). Default profile

handle.description: TikTok username without @, e.g. natgeo (for: profile, videos)
